context: A bus stop after school. Two teens — one Kansai-flavored, one Tokyo — both checking phones, end up exchanging exactly three sentences.
purpose: incidental teen encounter — phatic with the smallest possible humor

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Out of nowhere. Kansai cadence. Doesn't look up from her phone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Mumbled but real. Caught off-guard by being talked to. Voice cracks half a step.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: マジ、今日に限って、本当に。
lines.style: A real sigh. The shared misery solidarity of strangers.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: A real laugh, surprising himself. A beat of unguarded.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Stands. The conversation closes itself naturally.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: One syllable goodbye. Stays on his phone but smaller smile in the voice.
